# Aide — Offline-First Business Management Platform

> Aide is an offline-first POS, inventory and reporting app for Kenyan businesses — salons, shops, restaurants, pharmacies. Sell on the POS, track stock, print receipts, export sales. Works without internet and syncs when online.

**Live:** https://aide.omixsystems.store  
**GitHub:** https://github.com/oliver4441/aide  
**Company:** OmixSystems (Kenya)

## Tech Stack

- **Next.js 14** (App Router, TypeScript)
- **Tailwind CSS** with semantic color tokens
- **Prisma** → **Neon PostgreSQL** (offline-first sync)
- **NextAuth** (credentials + Google)
- **Dexie** (IndexedDB) for offline local storage
- **PWA**: manifest + service worker + installable
- **Tawk.to** live chat widget

## What Aide Does

- Point of Sale — scan products, add to cart, take cash or M-Pesa, generate receipts
- Inventory — add products, auto-generate SKUs, track quantity, low-stock alerts
- Sales history — activity log, filter by date, export as CSV/JSON, print receipts
- Reports & analytics — revenue charts (last 7 days), top products, payment method breakdown
- Settings — business profile, categories, sync conflicts, data export
- Offline-first — all data in IndexedDB, syncs to Neon when online
- Printable receipts — supermarket-grade, thermal + A4 PDF, QR code to share
- Admin console — businesses, users, sales, revenue, reviews

## Public Routes

- `/` — Landing page (features, pricing in KES, FAQ, download)
- `/help` — Help center (getting started, run guide, FAQ, contact)
- `/login` — Sign in (email/password or Google)
- `/r/[id]` — Shared receipt viewer (public)
- `/privacy` — Privacy policy (stub)
- `/terms` — Terms of service (stub)

## Auth

- Email/password sign-in via NextAuth credentials provider
- Google sign-in via Firebase Auth
- Session carries `role` (admin/user) + `businessId` for multi-business scoping
- Admin: `admin@aide.co.ke` / `admin123`
- Business user: `oliver@aide.co.ke` / `password123`

## Offline Sync

- Client is source of truth (IndexedDB via Dexie)
- Client generates UUIDs
- Sync to Neon via `POST /api/sync`
- Deterministic conflict resolver (LWW for descriptions, movement-ledger for stock)
- 30s auto-sync, outbox + retry/backoff

## SEO

- Canonical domain: `https://aide.omixsystems.store`
- Per-page unique title, description, OG image, Twitter card
- robots.txt → canonical host + sitemap
- sitemap.xml: `/`, `/help`, `/login`, `/privacy`, `/terms`
- Breadcrumbs on public pages
- Structured data: `SoftwareApplication` on landing page
